definitions.gloss: to start moving; to begin to move; to get into motion
definitions.explanation: To begin moving after being still. Used for physical objects, vehicles, and figuratively for projects, plans, or situations that begin to progress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧{動|うご}き{出|だ}した。
⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{動|うご}き{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The plan finally got into motion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{冬眠|とうみん}→冬眠：15853_toumin⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{動|うご}き{出|だ}す。
examples.english: When spring comes, the hibernating animals begin to stir.

notes:
FORMS:
Compound verb: ⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧ (to move) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to begin). The ～⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ pattern indicates the beginning of an action: ⟦{歩|ある}き{出|だ}す→歩き出す：30220_arukidasu⟧ (to start walking), ⟦{泣|な}き{出|だ}す→泣き出す：06343_nakidasu⟧ (to start crying), ⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}す→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧ (to start raining).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧{動|うご}き{出|だ}す (to start moving slowly)
- ⟦いよいよ→いよいよ：06353_iyoiyo⟧{動|うご}き{出|だ}す (to finally get going)
- ⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{動|うご}き{出|だ}す (to all start moving at once)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{動|うご}き{始|はじ}める→動き始める：21953_ugokihajimeru⟧: to begin to move — synonymous, slightly more formal
- ⟦{始動|しどう}する→始動する：19361_shidousuru⟧: to start up — technical, for machines and engines
- ⟦{発進|はっしん}する→発進する：21033_hasshinsuru⟧: to depart, to set off — for vehicles
